item.title: Steam Users Can Claim a Free RPG For a Limited Time
item.description:
Steam users can currently pick up the 2026 RPG Legends of Starkadia completely free of charge, but only until September 14. After that, the Steam game plans to transition to a paid model, but users can add it to their inventories before then and keep it forever for free.

Legends of Starkadia is the most recent game from developer Doom Turtle, best known for its action rogue-lite Ember Knights , which launched back in 2023. Both of its releases so far have extremely strong Steam reviews, which is why it comes as a surprise that its latest title is being handed out for free.

New Steam Game Looks Like an Unexpected Sequel to Inside

Years after Inside’s release, a new Steam game shows what would have happened if the Huddle had kept rolling.

By Joshua Duckworth

Legends of Starkadia is Free to Keep on Steam Before Moving to Paid Model

  • Claim Legends of Starkadia on Steam
  • Game transitions to paid model on September 14, 2026

In an announcement on Steam, Doom Turtle announced that Legends of Starkadia is moving to a paid model on September 14, after which it will cost $1.99. This is because the developer planned to scrap further work on the game and is using this transition to gauge whether there is any interest in continuing it. In this, the developer says that players should consider this "Chapter 1" of the turn-based RPG.

Free Game Giveaways

AllEnding SoonSteamEpicPrimePSNItch

Free Game Giveaways

As for the game itself, Legends of Starkadia is described by Doom Turtle as a "quirky turn-based RPG full of quick-time events and action-packed adventure." It has a fun cartoon art style, with 12 characters to unlock. At the time of writing, the game includes only one planet, but 11 are planned if the gaming community shows enough interest when it moves to the paid model. However, those who click the "Add to Library" button before then can keep it forever, 100% free of charge, so it's well worth getting in early.

The reviews for Legends of Starkadia are great among those who have played it so far. All 19 reviews are positive, hailing its animation style and obvious potential. Many of the reviews were given before Doom Turtle announced it might continue development by going paid, so they lament what might have been. It's charming, pretty, and plays well. For free, it's certainly not bad.

Steam Users Can Claim a Free RPG For a Limited Time
Splinter Cell Remake Screenshots Leak Online
Leaked LEGO PlayStation 1 Images Reveal Impressive Easter Eggs
Game of Thrones: The Blood of the Dragon Officially Announced

While this isn't part of Steam's regular Free to Keep promotion, it's an example of how PC gaming can be pretty budget-friendly for those who know where to look. There's definitely a prevailing sentiment that it can be expensive, and it's true - the barrier to entry can be pretty high. But for gamers willing to look across different storefronts, there's always something free to be found and kept forever.

item.title: The Heart Wants What It Wants Quest In The Blood of Dawnwalker
item.description:
To trigger The Heart Wants What It Wants quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker , you must interact with Ocha the Uriash inside the Tavern in Svartrau City. Go to the Altenmarkt Shrine, then head to the Tavern, marked by a cup icon on the map. There, use Focus Mode to find Ocha and talk to her.

How to Farm Glimpses in Mortal Shell 2

Here’s how to farm Glimpse Stones to get infinite Glimpses in Mortal Shell 2 and upgrade every single Shell to max level.

By Hamza Haq

The Heart Wants What It Wants Quest In The Blood of Dawnwalker

​​​​​​After speaking to her, Ocha will shove you; you can choose between:

  • I don't want any trouble.
  • Hands off, cow!

Both options don't matter, since Ocha will drag you to a fistfight either way. Beat Ocha, Heir of Clan Bakr, in a duel to continue with The Heart Wants What It Wants quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker .

Clan Bakr is the biggest Uriash clan in Vale Sangora, so Ocha holds great importance among her kind.

After winning the fight, Nora will appear, and Ocha apologizes for breaking the door. There will be some choices to make here, but none matter. So keep listening to the duo until you have three tasks to do:

  • Acquire Andrei's memento
  • Find a way into Andrei's hideout
  • Ask around to learn more about Andrei

How To Find A Way Into Andrei's Hideout

There are three ways to enter Andrei's Hideout in The Blood of Dawnwalker :

  • Wait until nighttime and use the vrakhiri power to climb the balcony.
  • Speak to the beggar in front of the butcher and pay 50 Denarii.
  • Speak to Katja nearby and pay 400 Denarii.

If you choose to speak to Katja, you must bring up Nora, ask about Andrei, then offer her 400 Denarii to help with her problem. The easiest route is to wait until night and climb, which lets you skip a lot of the conversations and risks . Going through the butcher's door will cause Nora to be held hostage , potentially leading to her death. You don't have to save Nora if you simply climb the balcony at night.

If you choose to go through the front door by speaking to the butcher, you must hold a piece of silver, then choose I have some silver to sell . Inside, make sure to comply with what was asked of you and don't upset Andrei, lest you want to fight him.

These are the safe options:

  • Here it is. (When speaking to the butcher.)
  • Alright, here. (When speaking to the butcher.)
  • [stay silent] (When seeing someone getting his hand cut off.)
  • Sorry. Do what you will. (After telling Andrei to leave the man alone.)
  • Here's what I've got. (When speaking about selling silver with Andrei.)
  • Who wouldn't be? What we're doing here is illegal. (When Andrei says you look nervous.)
  • I don't trust you, is all. (When Andrei says you look nervous.)
  • No wonder people don't want to work with you. (When Andrei threatens you with his cleaver.)
  • You know how to handle it, that's for sure. (When Andrei threatens you with his cleaver.)

These choices potentially lead to a fight:

  • I'll show it to Andrei. (When speaking to the butcher.)
  • Leave that man alone. (When seeing someone getting his hand cut off.)

These options will lead to a fight:

  • Just move. (When speaking to the butcher.)
  • I said let him go. (After telling Andrei to leave the man alone.)
  • I'm here to talk about Ocha. (All the choices after this lead to a fight.)
  • You don't impress me. (When Andrei says you look nervous.)
  • Your threats bore me. (When Andrei threatens you with his cleaver.)

How To Acquire Andrei's Memento (Should You Take The Cleaver, Pendant, or Ring?)

If you go through the front door, you have limited time to choose between these three options:

  • Take the cleaver.
  • Take the pendant.
  • Take the ring.

The correct memento is the ring . So if you choose to climb the balcony at night, make sure to give Ocha Andrei's Ring . The cleaver has little significance to Andrei, while the pendant belongs to Katja. There's one route you can follow to give the pendant back to Katja, but doing so means the hex will be unsuccessful. There's also no effect in the story. I managed to return the pendant by speaking to Katja and listening to her problem, giving her 400 Denarii, going through the butcher door and killing Andre, then speaking to Katja at the same time to return the pendant.

If you take the wrong memento, Nora may die if you choose to stay hidden instead of shouting: Step away from her!

How To Find A Way To Distract The Guard

There are two ways you can distract the guard in The Heart What It Wants quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker :

  • Speak to Katja and pay her 50 Denarii.
  • Free the pigs next to him by interacting with the fence.

Ocha Endings In The Heart Wants What It Wants Quest

There are three endings to Ocha in The Heart Wants What It Wants quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker . She can choose between:

  • Returning to her village.
  • Staying in the city. (Only if Andrei died by the hex.)
  • Exploring the world. (Only if you kill Andrei.)

However, her final decision depends on how you speak to her in the ending when you both sit by the river. The more you speak about home, the more she will decide to return . Likewise, the more you speak about staying in the city or exploring the world, the more she will decide to stay or explore. From my observation, here's how it goes:

Choice 1

  • Do you miss home? (Home point +1)
  • Do you like the city? (City point +1)
  • Why do you want to travel? (Explore point +1)

Choice 2

  • New things can be exciting, sure. (City point or Explore point +1)
  • Meh. Nothing better than homemade food! (Home point +1)

Choice 3

  • Our neighbours helped a bit. (City point or Explore point +1)
  • Other villagers just cared about themselves. (Home point +1)

Ocha will decide based on the option with the highest points. So if you get 2 Home points and 1 City point, she will decide to go home.

Here are some other lengthy quests in The Blood of Dawnwalker : Letters to Lunka quest, Lost Blood quest, Firebrand quest, and Echoes of Silenced Bells quest.

item.title: Good Home Quest Choices Guide In The Blood of Dawnwalker
item.description:
The Good Home quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker takes players on a journey to help Heile, the little girl in a mysterious burrow. At the end of the quest, your response will determine whether Heile stays with the Sanzhani or if she returns with her brother. In the worst-case scenario, someone will die in this mission.

Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 - Bad Blood Quest Walkthrough

Bad Blood is an essential mission to increase reputation further with Pavlena in Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2.

By Mehrdad Khayyat

Good Home Quest In The Blood of Dawnwalker

You can start the Good Home quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker by finding the Sanzhani burrow in the middle of the Svartrau Outskirts area. Head to the Sandy Gorge Shrine, then go east, following the ravine until you see some red mushroom rings. Follow these mushroom rings until you find the Sanzhani burrows.

Head here if you're looking for all Sanzhani locations for Letters to Lunka quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker .

Crouch to enter until you meet Heile. She will tell you that she wishes to meet her brother, Tonis. This is why Coen manages to find the Sanzhani burrows.

Investigate Oghasti

Head to the Eastern Road to Oghasti Shrine, then find a house with blue shutters. There's a cross sign by the door, indicating a plague has ravaged the house. Investigate Heile and Tonis's House, then head to the Wooden Palace.

Investigate the Wooden Palace

Go upstairs and investigate the candle, apple, axe, camp in the distance, and chair. All this allows Coen to guess that someone is still coming to this place to light the candle, likely for Heile. Since there's an axe and the chair is filled with soot, Coen deduces that the person is a coal burner, likely from the nearby camp.

Ask About Tonis In The Burner Camp

Now, head to the Woodcutters's Camp, south of the Woodcutters's Camp Shrine, and speak to the Coal Burner Chief. He will tell you that there's a Tonis, but he lives alone in the northeast. You can find him by following trees marked with X.

Should You Give Tonis A Drink Or Give Him A Hand?

When you talk to Tonis, you have two options:

  • Will you talk if I get you a drink?
  • How about I give you a hand? (uses 3 Time Segments).

You can choose the first option if you have a wine or beer in your inventory, which should be easy if you don't store everything in your storage. This option is much preferable to save time.

When Tonis asks you to see Heile, you can choose from:

  • Sure thing. Follow me.
  • I'll meet you there.

If you choose the first option, you'll automatically go to the Sanzhani burrow. Meanwhile, the latter choice means you have to head there manually.

Good Home Quest Endings

There are three endings to the Good Home quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker :

  • Heile stays with the Sanzhani
  • Tonis gets angry and threatens to attack the burrow
  • Heile returns with Tonis

The ending you get depends on what you say when Tonis meets Heile and the Sanzhani.

Heile Stays With The Sanzhani

Heile stays with the Sanzhani and Tonis can visit her once per moon. The Sanzhani says Heile won't stay with them forever, though. So one day, she has to return to humanity.

You get this ending by saying:

Option 1

  • Tonis, Heile is happy here. Let her stay.
  • You can't provide for her.
  • She's safe here. For the first time in her life.

Option 2

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • They have a point, Tonis...
  • You can't provide for her.
  • She's safe here. For the first time in her life.

Tonis Attacks The Burrow

Tonis will get angry and threaten to attack the burrow. His attempt will fail, of course, and he will die.

You get this ending by choosing:

Option 1

  • Tonis, Heile is happy here. Let her stay.
  • You speak as if you owned her.

Option 2

  • Tonis, Heile is happy here. Let her stay.
  • You can't provide for her.
  • We humans - are we so much better? Or Don't call them that.

Option 3

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • And what future awaits her here?
  • No. I refuse.

Option 4

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • [say nothing]

Option 5

  • [stay quiet]

Option 6

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • They have a point, Tonis...
  • You can't provide for her.
  • We humans - are we so much better? Or Don't call them that.

Heile Returns With Tonis

Heile leaves the Sanzhani and returns with Tonis. Tonis struggles to provide for both of them, but Heile tries her best to help. He mentions that Heile will be old enough to be sent away in a few years, and some of the other Coal Burners have already asked for her hand.

However, to complete this ending, you need to have at least three Shiny Tooth to give the Tsarina. You can get Shiny Tooth in The Blood of Dawnwalker by killing enemies. You can even get them randomly throughout the world. For example, the pig pen by Andrei's house in Svartrau city hides one Shiny Tooth inside the haystack.

This ending is available if you pick:

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • And what future awaits her here?
  • I can do that, yes.

  • Tonis, Heile is happy here. Let her stay.
  • You speak as if you owned her.

  • You can't provide for her.
  • We humans - are we so much better? Or Don't call them that.

Option 3

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • And what future awaits her here?
  • No. I refuse.

Option 4

  • [say nothing]

Option 5

  • [stay quiet]

Option 6

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • They have a point, Tonis...
  • You can't provide for her.
  • We humans - are we so much better? Or Don't call them that.

Heile Returns With Tonis

Heile leaves the Sanzhani and returns with Tonis. Tonis struggles to provide for both of them, but Heile tries her best to help. He mentions that Heile will be old enough to be sent away in a few years, and some of the other Coal Burners have already asked for her hand.

However, to complete this ending, you need to have at least three Shiny Tooth to give the Tsarina. You can get Shiny Tooth in The Blood of Dawnwalker by killing enemies. You can even get them randomly throughout the world. For example, the pig pen by Andrei's house in Svartrau city hides one Shiny Tooth inside the haystack.

This ending is available if you pick:

  • The girl should live among her own kind.
  • And what future awaits her here?
  • I can do that, yes.

item.title: Lost Blood Quest In The Blood of Dawnwalker
item.description:
To complete the Lost Blood quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker , you must speak to the merchant in Svartrau city and tell him about the fate of his son. Wait around a day for him to grieve, then return to him once more. You'll get more information regarding what happened, and finally be rewarded for finishing the mission.

House of the Soulless Quest Guide In Genshin Impact

Here's how to solve the puzzle in the Secret Room to complete the House of the Soulless quest in Genshin Impact.

By Nahda Nabiilah

Lost Blood Quest In The Blood of Dawnwalker

You can trigger the Lost Blood quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker by exploring the northern part of St. Tyna's Grove. Head north from the Pilgrim's Trail Shrine, and soon you'll find destroyed barrels filled with blood. Investigate the cart using Focus Mode, then follow the blood trails into a cave. Beat the Murohn inside to progress with the quest.

You can skip the investigation if you want, but it's much easier to follow the track if you follow the quest direction.

You can also do this quest backward, where you find the Murohn inside a cave first, then follow the trail back to the cart to discover what had happened. Both ways will lead to the same track, where you must:

  • Investigate the Murohn corpse to find a Mysterious Ring.
  • Investigate the cave and read the Letter from Father to know who the Murohn was.

Next, you need to find the letter's author in Silberstein .

You also get a Phial of Ambrus's Blood in this quest. You can consume it to unlock Ambrus's skill without having to fight him.

How To Find The Letter's Author In Silberstein

A Letter from Father gives you the following clue: The Murohn was a man from Silberstein, and the father has a shop. Therefore, when you try to find the letter's author in Silberstein, you should check out the merchants nearby first.

Teleport to the Silberstein Shrine on the eastern side of Svartrau City, then head south to the merchant. Speak to the Silberstein General Trader, and tell him about your findings. You can choose to say:

  • He wasn't human anymore!
  • I am sorry.

Neither has any impact, except a small change in the dialogue. After that, the merchant will close the shop, upset with the ordeal.

Wait around one day until he's ready to talk, then speak with the Silberstein General Trader again. He apologizes for snapping at you, and thanks you for ending his son's misery. Now, he will ask you if you still have the ring or not. You can say I do or I don't , depending on what you want to do. Even if you say "I do," he will ask you to sell his ring back to him, and you can buy it straight back. So there's not much impact here either.

Check out more of our The Blood of Dawnwalker guides: all Sanzhani locations for the Letters to Lunka quest, how to romance Anca, how to romance Lacra, and Watermill Hills treasure location.

item.title: Should You Leave the Valley or Stay In The Blood of Dawnwalker?
item.description:
During the Prologue, the story will unfold and explain to you how the people of Vale Sangora are trapped within the Valley, making them an easy target for Brencis and his companions in The Blood of Dawnwalker . However, if you think that exiting the Valley is a myth, it is not, as during your exploration of the Coward's Path area, you'll come across an exit. Interacting with it will make you choose between staying or leaving. If the choice leaves you conflicted, follow this article to learn what each option will lead to in The Blood Of Dawnwalker .

Svartrau Cathedral Treasury Location In The Blood Of Dawnwalker

Locate the Svartrau Cathedral's Treasury to obtain the Phial of Xanthe's Blood and the Stone Key in The Blood of Dawnwalker.

By Nahda Nabiilah

The following article contains spoilers, so read at your own risk!

Should You Leave The Valley or Stay In The Valley?

After finding the Valley exit in Coward’s Path, you are faced with the choice of abandoning everyone, including your family, and escaping the Valley, or staying and helping everyone against the Vrakhiri. This choice will leave you wondering which choice to make and what each choice might lead to. The answer is quite easy here: there is no right answer, as both will lead to different consequences.

If You Choose To Stay In The Valley

You will continue Coen's journey normally and will need to follow the main quest to save his family from Brencis in The Blood of Dawnwalker . You'll have to do this during a period of 30 in-game days, which passes by spending your time doing side quests for other companions or NPCs.

If You Choose To Leave The Valley

Now, if you choose to exit the Valley of Vale Sangora, you'll end the game early, and Coen will escape the responsibility of saving his family and all the Valley residents. Phew!

You'll get the A Hero They Deserve Hidden Achievement after choosing to exit the Valley, and The Blood of Dawnwalker Achievement, if it's your first time completing the game.

However, that is not all you'll get for ending the game quickly. If you skip or watch the credits, you'll trigger a special cutscene that features an injured Coen in the modern world where an unknown entity will be chasing him. This will only leave you with more questions about who that could be, and how Coen ends up there, wounded and chased by whom?

Throughout my playthrough, I tried getting the other endings, and that didn't change the outcome of the cutscene, even when Brencis was defeated.

How To Exit The Valley In The Blood of Dawnwalker

To exit the valley and trigger a special ending in The Blood of Dawnwalker , you need to do the following:

  • Make sure it's nighttime first .
  • Fast travel to Coward's Path Shrine, on the west side of the map.
  • Move towards the broken bridge, which triggers the Cursed Chasm quest.
  • Ignore the quest and use your Shadowstep Ability to cross to the other side of the broken bridge (for this to work, you may have to level up your Shadow Dweller Ability once to expand the Shadowstep traveling distance).
  • If you can't reach the other side of the bridge, you can climb the cliff slowly.
  • Walk west towards the open door within the walls.

Make sure to save before approaching the door, so you can keep your progress, in case you choose to venture outside the Valley in The Blood of Dawnwalker . Upon approaching the open door, two options will appear:

  • [Leave the Valley forever]
  • [Stay in the Valley]

Choose based on the information provided above to see what each option leads to.

If you're looking for more The Blood of Dawnwalker guides, check these: Should You Stay Silent Or Speak Up During the Mass? Should You Keep On Looking Or Call For Anca? Or Should You Practice Your Latin With Anca?
